data_fields.name: visible_radius_factor
data_fields.donor_constant: max(panel w, h) x 0.7071 (in pixels, compared as tiles)

best_idea: A hero-centred minimap that pre-renders the tile map once per zoom level, shows only explored tiles, and draws the hero, living allies and engaged foes (not idle foes) inside a radius.
decision_why: Take the pre-rendered zoom ladder, the explored-tile gate and the rule that only engaged foes get a dot; fix the mode cycle (the key never reaches hidden), the teleport fog index and the body fog gate; do not port the pixel-as-tile radius as written.
acceptance: On a 375-wide phone the minimap shows the hero in white, allies in yellow and foes in combat in red only; unexplored tiles and idle foes are blank; a unit test asserts nextMode(normal) is 2x, nextMode(2x) is hidden and nextMode(hidden) is normal.
